MAR — Marine Excursion

Prison Island + Nakupenda sandbank

Half day to 6 hours · Stone Town → Changuu → Nakupenda

From $42–$145 per person
Book via WhatsApp

Overview

A classic Zanzibar half-day or full-day excursion: take a short boat ride to Changuu (Prison Island) to meet the resident giant Aldabra tortoises, then cruise to Nakupenda sandbank for snorkeling over coral gardens.

What to Expect

  • Boat transfer from Stone Town (20 minutes)
  • Prison Island visit — feed and photograph giant tortoises (aged 70–190)
  • Nakupenda sandbank — wade in shallow turquoise waters
  • Snorkeling at the coral reef (gear provided)
  • Island entry fee included
  • Duration: half day (3 hours) or full day (6 hours with lunch)

Duration & Meeting Point

Duration: Half day (3 hours) to full day (6 hours)

Meeting point: Stone Town waterfront — Forodhani Gardens pier

Important Notes

  • Peak season (June–October) gets crowded — book early morning for fewer people
  • Bring reef-safe sunscreen and a hat
  • Lunch at Nakupenda is typically a simple seafood grill — add $10–15 if desired

Inclusions

  • Boat, guide, entry
  • lunch varies

📍 Tour Details

  • Location:Stone Town → Changuu → Nakupenda
